system_description.narrative_title: Escalating U.S.-Iran regional conflict and global energy/security fallout
system_description.narrative_summary: An open, dynamic system centered on rising U.S.-Iran tensions and related proxy attacks (notably Houthi strikes) that are propagating security, diplomatic and market responses across the Gulf and beyond. Flows of military action, intelligence warnings, diplomatic mediation and energy supply disruptions interact through reinforcing and balancing feedbacks — driving embassy evacuations, allied military posturing, threats to maritime and undersea infrastructure, and volatile oil/LNG markets. External inputs (U.S. policy choices, Iranian strategy, proxy actions, and mediator interventions) and outputs (price shocks, evacuation orders, expanded air/maritime security measures) continuously reshape the system state.
system_description.scope: Regional security interactions among the U.S., Iran, Iran-backed proxies (Houthis, Hezbollah), Gulf states and mediators; adjacent military deployments, embassy and base security, attacks on aviation/energy infrastructure and undersea cables; short- to medium-term impacts on oil/LNG flows, global energy markets, and diplomatic negotiations.
system_description.super_system: Global geopolitical-economic order (international security, trade and energy markets)
adjacent_subsystems: Global energy markets and supply chains (oil, LNG, shipping routes)
International diplomatic mediation and security alliances (U.S., Gulf states, Qatar, regional partners)
Maritime and undersea infrastructure and commercial shipping security
Regional non-state/proxy warfare networks (Houthis, Hezbollah, ISIS affiliates)

variables.name: Military tension level
variables.description: The overall intensity of interstate and cross-border military confrontation and hostile readiness in the region.

variables.name: Proxy attack rate
variables.description: The frequency at which non-state or proxy forces carry out offensive operations against military, civilian, or infrastructure targets.

variables.name: Military deployment scale
variables.description: The aggregate number and concentration of deployed military forces, platforms and materiel positioned in or directed toward the region.

variables.name: Maritime security risk
variables.description: The probability and potential severity of hostile incidents affecting shipping, ports, and sea lanes in the adjacent maritime domain.

variables.name: Undersea infrastructure vulnerability
variables.description: The susceptibility of subsea assets (cables, pipelines, and related installations) to damage, interdiction, or disruption from hostile activity.

variables.name: Energy supply disruption risk
variables.description: The likelihood that oil, gas, or LNG production and transit will be interrupted or constrained by security-related actions.

variables.name: Global oil price level
variables.description: The prevailing market price of benchmark crude oil reflecting supply-demand balance and risk premia attributed to regional instability.

variables.name: LNG market tightness
variables.description: The degree of spare capacity and delivery flexibility in global liquefied natural gas markets relative to demand.

variables.name: Commercial shipping disruption rate
variables.description: The rate at which commercial maritime movements are delayed, rerouted, or suspended due to security incidents or risk mitigation.

variables.name: Diplomatic mediation activity
variables.description: The volume and intensity of diplomatic engagements, negotiations, and third-party mediation efforts aimed at de-escalation.

variables.name: Intelligence warning frequency
variables.description: The cadence with which actionable intelligence alerts and threat advisories about imminent hostile acts are produced and circulated.

variables.name: Embassy and personnel security alert level
variables.description: The prevailing protective posture and formal threat level assigned to diplomatic missions and associated personnel.

variables.name: Public risk perception of conflict
variables.description: The aggregate perception among civilian populations and markets of the likelihood and impact of broader conflict escalation.

variables.name: Allied coalition cohesion
variables.description: The degree of alignment and coordinated political-military action among partner actors responding to the crisis.

variables.name: Civilian casualty and displacement rate
variables.description: The rate at which civilian populations experience casualties, forced movement, or refugee flows due to conflict-related violence.

catalysts.title: Possible U.S. military strike on Iran
catalysts.description: U.S. forces staged and rearmed, and senior U.S. officials signal a near-term decision on further military operations against Iran.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "Trump says US may do another military operation against Iran"; "Aboard USS George Washington as It Rearms for Possible Iran Strikes".

catalysts.title: Continued Houthi missile/drone attacks
catalysts.description: Houthis are carrying out repeated strikes on Saudi infrastructure and airports, with continued attacks likely to persist near term.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "Houthis say they attacked Saudi oil pumping stations, Riyadh airport"; "Houthis say they hit Saudi Ras Tanura oil refinery with missile".

catalysts.title: Qatar-led diplomatic mediation in Tehran
catalysts.description: Qatar is mediating talks in Tehran in coordination with the U.S. and regional actors to reduce tensions and prevent wider escalation.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: "Qatari mediators in Tehran for U.S.-coordinated effort to ease tensions"; "Saudi-led coalition says... push for peace in Tehran".

catalysts.title: Increased embassy evacuations and security alerts
catalysts.description: Diplomatic missions are tightening posture and some personnel are departing high-risk postings, raising formal alert levels across the region.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "American embassies tighten security as Iran threat warnings intensify"; "US orders diplomats to depart Saudi Arabia".

catalysts.title: Qatar extends LNG force majeure to end-December
catalysts.description: Qatar formally extended force majeure on LNG cargoes to Italy's Edison through end-December, constraining European deliveries.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: "Qatar extends force majeure on LNG cargoes to Italy's Edison until end-December".

catalysts.title: Risk of attacks on Gulf undersea cables
catalysts.description: Official reporting indicates Iran has detailed plans to target undersea cables if hostilities resume, elevating risk to subsea infrastructure.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: "Iran has detailed plans to hit Gulf undersea cables if war resumes, officials say".

catalysts.title: Hezbollah mobilisation and funding increase
catalysts.description: Reporting indicates Hezbollah is preparing for a potential broader regional war with increased financial backing from Iran.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: "Hezbollah readies for new regional war with funds from Iran, sources say".

catalysts.title: Egypt approves military support for Saudi Arabia
catalysts.description: Egypt's approval to support Saudi responses to Houthi attacks may drive regional deployments and coalition activity.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: "Egypt approves military support for Saudi Arabia after Houthi attacks escalate".

catalysts.title: U.S. midterm elections and heightened threat warnings
catalysts.description: U.S. midterm elections create a near-term political milestone that is already linked to intensified threat warnings and diplomatic posturing.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: "American embassies tighten security as Iran threat warnings intensify ahead of U.S. midterm elections".

catalysts.title: Widening oil spill off UAE
catalysts.description: An expanding oil spill off the UAE is causing beach closures and could disrupt commercial shipping and port operations in the short term.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: "Oil spill off UAE widens, satellite images show, prompting more beach closures".
